name: HALLIBURTON CO.  DL 2,50
summary: Halliburton Company is one of the world's largest providers of products and services to the energy industry. The company serves the upstream oil and gas industry throughout the lifecycle of the reservoir, from locating hydrocarbons and managing geological data, to drilling and formation evaluation, well construction and completion, and optimizing production. Halliburton is headquartered in Houston, Texas.
